---
name: foreign-skill
description: Convert a Markdown changelog into GitHub release notes grouped by section. Use when the user asks to draft release notes, write a release announcement from a changelog, or turn CHANGELOG entries into a GitHub release. NOT for writing the changelog entries themselves or for tagging and publishing the release.
---

# foreign-skill

A skill written by hand, outside `skillz`: it has `evals/evals.json` but no `.factory/`.

1. Read the changelog section for the requested version.
2. Group the entries under their existing headings; never invent an entry.
3. Write one headline sentence, then the grouped notes.
